QA_Issues.field: current admin SEO fields/current admin alt
QA_Issues.source_observation: Storefront metadata and product.js media alt were readable, but no Shopify admin export was provided.
QA_Issues.reason: Storefront values cannot prove admin fields or future import mapping.
QA_Issues.recommended_fix: Provide a frozen Shopify admin/export snapshot before deployment approval.
QA_Issues.recheck_condition: Admin export revision and hash are frozen and compared.

QA_Issues.source_observation: Frozen product JSON/body/options/gallery URLs match live, but old rendered metadata cannot be compared directly.
QA_Issues.reason: Snapshot HTML cũ không đọc được nên không thể dùng hash HTML để kết luận drift.
QA_Issues.recommended_fix: Capture a fresh immutable HTML snapshot for the next revision.
QA_Issues.recheck_condition: Both old and new readable HTML snapshots are available with hashes.

QA_Issues.submitted_value: Customizer root, button, upload endpoint and Name/Number schema verified in live HTML for all 10 products.
QA_Issues.source_observation: An interactive browser was unavailable, so the final cart-line persistence and fulfillment payload were not executed.
QA_Issues.reason: Cấu hình live hỗ trợ claim personalization, nhưng chưa kiểm thử end-to-end đến giỏ hàng.
QA_Issues.recommended_fix: Run one controlled Customize-to-cart transaction per configuration revision before deployment approval.
QA_Issues.recheck_condition: Cart line retains the entered name, optional number, preview and variant mapping.
